# Meridian Bio Q2 Call

## Clinical trials

Enrollment for the lead therapy trial will finish in September. The company expects primary data early next year.

## Regulatory approvals

Meridian expects a regulator decision on its lead therapy in the third quarter of next year.

## Commercialization

The company will launch the therapy after regulatory clearance. Management expects initial product revenue in the following quarter.
